quantiles: nearest rank; 120 frames per combined cell, 60 per direction; small-window p99 is close to max
measurementBoundary: FarmSession pulse + presentation + renderer; excludes app DOM/HUD/input. Instrumented RAF intervals are not an uninstrumented whole-app FPS claim.
scope: Real Garden/FarmSession/renderer population fixture; fixed seed/camera/clock. RAF interval includes browser wait; CPU and GPU are separate and never summed.
steadyImageScope: SDK image atlas uploads/bake, not browser DOM image cache; numeric pose/instance updates remain measured
memoryScope: Logical SDK allocations; texture bytes include render-target textures. Never add renderTargetBytes again. Does not measure total physical VRAM/default framebuffer/driver caches.
notes: Native and sprite share new authored-face selection; this isolates the rendering choice, not all changes versus old main.
1000 farm is the configured maximum. Active combat is tested at 100/500, matching max frontline500.
Both orders run after24 warmup frames;60 samples per run. No other local tests ran concurrently.
Earlier unsuccessful/adverse measurements remain outside this new source-pinned run.
